answer: The registry sells a scarce terrace slot to each new agent only after a refundable bond is locked and a one-shot verifiable delay proof is signed under a falcon key unique to that slot. The proof digest is published as a ledger pigment; any later identity that reuses the same pigment or key is slashed and the bond burned. Because each fake needs its own slot, bond, and delay proof, the cost of a voting swarm grows linearly with the number of identities rather than being copied from one script.
